Grade: PP1
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: ORNAMENTS 8.1 Beading By the end of the sub-strand the • Guide Learners to ident
Topic 8.2: Bracelet making ORNAMENTS

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Bracelet making ORNAMENTS. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How did you make your enjoyment making bracelet?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. appreciate own and others collection and in making finished work. bracelets. • display the made bracelets, appreciate own and others work

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. appreciate own and others collection and in making finished work. bracelets. • display the made bracelets, appreciate own and others work
   In simple words: practise until you can appreciate own and others collection and in making finished work. bracelets. • display the made bracelets, appreciate own and others work. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Bracelet making ORNAMENTS using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Bracelet making ORNAMENTS in the examples.
2. Explain Bracelet making ORNAMENTS to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Bracelet making ORNAMENTS.
4. Show that you can: appreciate own and others collection and in making finished work. bracelets. • display the made bracelets, appreciate own and others work

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Bracelet making ORNAMENTS using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Bracelet making ORNAMENTS important for a PP1 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. The learner attempts to explain with assistance work available materials finished work

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. appreciate own and others collection and in making finished work. bracelets. • display the made bracelets, appreciate own and others work
